column2: The members the Google sign-in may name, at most 64; a start naming more is refused.
Google sign-ins under way at once; a sign-in started past them is answered the busy page.
A Google sign-in's life, from its start to its return, and the sign-in cookie's Max-Age.
Exchanges with Google at once; more wait for one to end.
An answer's body from Google, its key set or a token, at most 65536; a longer answer fails the sign-in.
A configured Google endpoint, and the authorization URL given to the browser; a longer endpoint refuses the start.
The Google client secret's file; a longer one refuses the start.
The repositories one read of a forge's repository picker shows, from 1 to 100; the forge's own page cap may show fewer.
The query of a forge's setup routes on the clients' listener, as a GitHub App's returns; a longer one is answered 400.
The engine's commits awaiting the store's durability; past them, new decisions wait.
Outputs the engine holds until their commit is durable, at least 3 times `root.journal.deliveries`.
Writes in one of the engine's commits, the deployment's record among them; the start checks it against the engine's worst case.
Outputs of one decision of the engine's; the start checks it against `tasks.tasks`, the people's waiters and the fleet's workers.
A row of the engine's journal, a chat's turn among them; it holds the agent's largest turn, which the start checks.
A task's result or a brief as the engine holds it, at least `root.brief.brief_bytes`, `tasks.result_bytes` and `people.words`.
A run's charter as the engine holds it; a configured charter past it refuses the start.
Pages the engine loads from its store at once, at least 2; more wait.
Rows in one page the engine loads from its store, at least 2.
A page the engine keeps of what it loads, cut before the first row past it; it holds the agent's largest turn.
What one person's read of the store brings, its rows included; it holds the agent's largest turn with its row.
A page the store answers the engine, decoded, at least `root.loads.bytes`; a larger page fails.
One row of a page the engine loads, a turn among them; it holds the agent's largest turn, which the start checks.
Briefs the engine gathers at once, a brief being what a run reads when it starts.
Sections in one brief: the task, its dependencies, CI, reviews and the others.
Parts read for one section of a brief.
What one section of a brief may read; a larger section is missing from the brief.
A run's whole brief, which its sections share, each cut to fit, at most `root.journal.result_bytes`.
How long the engine gathers a brief before it gives up on the sections still missing.
The task's section of a brief, its spec, contract and requester; cut to fit.
The dependencies' section of a brief; cut to fit.
The CI section of a brief; cut to fit.
The reviews' section of a brief; cut to fit.
The pull request's section of a brief; cut to fit.
The earlier attempts' section of a brief; cut to fit.
The plan's section of a brief; cut to fit.
The notes' section of a brief, within `root.brief.read_bytes`; cut to fit.
Repositories adopted across every forge, at most `forge.client.repositories`; an adoption past it is refused as too large.
Tasks that hold forge resources or effects at once, at least `tasks.tasks`; a task past it is refused.
Forge resources held by tasks at once, at most `forge.client.resources`; a hold past it is refused.
Topics of the forges followed at once, CI reads among them; a subscription past it is refused.
Writes to the forges awaiting them, at most `forge.client.entries`; a write past it is refused.
Runs' calls to the forges held until answered, at least `core.call_records`.
Changes on their way to landing at once; a change past it is refused.
Tracked goals shown as issues at once; past it, a goal's issue fails.
Repositories one task may name, equal to `checkout.repositories`; a task naming more is refused.
Paths one subscription follows, and files read of one pull request; past it, the files are unknown.
A forge's name for an owner, a repository or a branch; a longer one is refused, and the longest remote must fit `checkout.name_bytes`.
Outputs the forge reserves for one step, at least what its holds, subscriptions and calls need, which the start checks.
Counted in the forge's worst case only; nothing reads it at run time.
Adoptions under way at once; another is answered busy.
Adoption answers kept for a request asked again, with those under way; past it, an adoption is answered busy.
Collaborators one adoption reads; a repository with more is refused as too large.
Landings remembered at once; past it, a landing's news names no files.
Projects with landing rules of their own, at least the projects configured.
Landing rules in the deployment's table or one project's; more refuse the start.
Brief sections the forges gather at once, at least `root.brief.briefs` times `root.brief.sections` times 2.
One brief section a forge gathers, at least `root.brief.read_bytes`; a larger section fails.
How long a ready change waits before it goes ahead of every change that became ready after it, whatever their priority.
Calls to a forge queued and in flight, at least `forge.client.calls`; a read past it is answered busy.
Calls to a forge in flight at once, equal to `forge_component.connections`; more wait.
Requests to a forge in one rate window; past it, calls wait for the next window.
Requests of each rate window reserved so that waiting work is still served, at most `forge.client.rate`.
A forge's rate window, after which `forge.client.rate` requests are allowed again.
One forge call's own bytes, its rows among them; a larger call is refused as too large.
One answer from a forge, decoded, a file or a job log among them; a larger answer fails as too large.
Rows in one page of a forge's answer, and a listing's page size; a larger answer fails.
Comments and reviews remembered for one pull request or issue; one with more fails to read as too large.
Tries of a forge read before its error stands.
The first wait before a forge read or write is tried again, doubling up to `forge.client.backoff_max_ms`.
The longest wait between two tries of a forge read or write.
Writes to a forge kept until done, at least `forge.entries`; another is answered busy.
Tries of a forge write before it fails as unavailable.
The longest a sent write may take to reach a forge, at least `forge_component.deadline_ms`; a write whose fate is unknown waits it out.
An allowance for the clock's moves, added to `forge.client.lifetime_ms` before a write whose fate is unknown is settled.
Forge resources watched at once, pull requests and issues among them, at least `forge.holds`; past it, a watch is answered busy.
Repositories watched across the forges, and a set-up forge's adopted list, at least `forge.repositories`; past it, busy.
How often a watched resource is read again, the wait doubling up to `forge.client.poll_max_ms`.
The longest wait between two reads of a watched resource.
The wait before a resource is read again once a webhook or a write hints that it changed.
The wait before a slow read of a resource or a repository.
After a pull request's head or base moves, how long a not mergeable answer or a hinted job's pending CI is read again and not believed.
A forge client's diagnostic facts awaiting the log; past it, a fact is dropped and counted.
Repairs one change may delegate; past it, the change is held.
Conflict resolutions one change may delegate; past it, the change is held.
Updates of one change's branch to its base; past it, the change is held.
How long a change waits on its forge before it is held as stalled.
Gates one change keeps, and the landing rules one table holds; more rules refuse the start.
A change's earlier heads remembered across clean updates; past it, the change is held.
Items of a goal's plan shown in its issue.
Milestones listed in a goal's issue; later ones are summed up.
A goal's issue title; cut to fit.
A goal's issue body, its goal and plan; cut to fit.
A comment on a goal's issue, for a milestone or the end; cut to fit.
The least time between two updates of a goal's issue.
Workspaces a worker keeps on disk, at least its slots; past it, the least recent idle one goes, and with none idle a checkout is busy.
Repositories one checkout holds, equal to `forge.resources_per_task` and within the agent's directories.
A checkout's key, a repository's name or remote, or a branch, at most the agent's; a longer one is refused.
A commit's message, title and body, at least the agent's largest call; a longer one is refused.
Conflicted paths one repository may hold, within the agent's; 0 starts no merge.
One conflicted path, within the agent's; a longer one fails the merge, and 0 starts none.
How long a clone, fetch, branch or push may take before it times out.
How long a local checkout, merge or commit may take before it times out.
A checkout's diagnostic facts awaiting the log; past it, a fact is dropped and counted.
Git operations a worker runs at once, at least `checkout.workspaces`; another fails.
The output kept of one git operation, at least what the checkout parses; more fails the operation.
The tail of one git operation's errors kept for its diagnostic.
One read of a conflicted file while it is scanned.
Entries read in one page while a worker clears its trash.
The names read in one page while a worker clears its trash.
The web client's files, its page among them; a bundle with more refuses the start.
The web client's files in all, held in memory while `temper serve` runs; a larger bundle refuses the start.
A forge's record or a value temper carries, such as a pasted token; a longer value is refused, named.
The installations a GitHub forge accepts, at most `forge_component.installations`.
Checked at the start alone, at most 4 and at most `forge_component.log_origins`; nothing reads it at run time.
The origins a GitHub job log's redirect may reach, per forge, at least `forges.log_origins`; a redirect elsewhere is refused.
The wait between two reads of a GitHub App's delivery log.
How far back a GitHub App's delivery log is read when a forge starts again in one process, at most a day.
Pages one read of a GitHub App's delivery log takes; the rest waits for the next read.
One delivery read from a GitHub App's delivery log; a larger one hints nothing.
The installations whose tokens a GitHub forge keeps, at least `forges.installations`.
A GitHub App's private key, at least 1196 with a GitHub forge; a larger key is refused.
How long before an installation's token expires it is minted again, from twice `forge_component.deadline_ms` to 30 minutes.
The forges configured, in all; more refuse the start.
A forge's token: an API token, a git token or a site admin's; a longer one is refused.
Connections to a forge for calls, equal to `forge.client.calls`; a call waits for one.
The head of a forge's HTTP answer; a longer head fails the call.
The header fields of a forge's answer or a webhook's request; a webhook with more is answered 431.
A forge's answer body as it streams in; a longer one fails to decode.
The nesting of a forge's JSON, at least 8; a deeper document fails.
The piece in which a forge's answer is read and decoded; it bounds no whole.
A text in a forge's answer, a name, title, path or link, at least `forge.name_bytes`; a longer one fails the answer.
A body kept from a forge, as a pull request's or a comment's, and a write's body with its marker; a longer one fails.
The items of a list inside one document from a forge; more fail the document.
The target of one HTTP request to a forge, its path and query; a longer one is refused.
Repositories whose lookups a forge keeps, at most `forge.repositories`; past it, the least recent goes.
Users whose logins a forge keeps; past it, the least recent goes.
The plaintext read at once from a forge's TLS connection.
The plaintext sent at once on a forge's TLS connection; a request head past it is refused.
The ciphertext kept of a TLS handshake with a forge, at least 18437; a longer handshake message fails.
Webhook connections at once, in all; more wait.
A webhook delivery's request head; a longer one is answered 431.
A webhook delivery's body, read as it streams; a longer one is answered 413 and hints nothing.
A Forgejo forge's webhook secret, at least 32; a longer one is refused.
A webhook delivery's read and answer, from its connection's accept or its last answer; past it, the connection closes.
A call to a forge, and each read as a forge starts, at most `forge.client.lifetime_ms`; past it, the call fails.
How long an idle connection to a forge stays open.
The first wait before a forge's start is tried again, doubling up to `forge_component.start_backoff_max_ms`.
The longest wait between two tries of a forge's start.
Setup runs at once, a forge's writing run and its reachability read both counted; a request past them is answered busy.
One-time states held for a GitHub App's manifest and installation returns; past it, the oldest goes.
A one-time return state's life, at most an hour; a return after it fails.
The orgs a managed forge's setup entry may name; more refuse the start.
A forge's setup run, its wait for the forge among it, above `setup.backoff_max_ms`; past it, the run stops.
The first wait before a setup request is made again, doubling up to `setup.backoff_max_ms`.
The longest wait between two tries of a setup request, below `setup.deadline_ms`.
A fetched binary, written to its part file as it streams; one past it removes the part file and is refused, naming the URL.
The first wait before the box restarts a step that exited, doubling up to `box.backoff_max_ms`.
The longest wait before the box restarts a step, below `box.window_ms`.
A step's exits within `box.window_ms` past which the box gives up, at most 64.
The window in which a step's exits count against `box.restarts`.
A step's grace after each of its stop's two signals.
A line of the box's pipe either way, its line feed among them, at least 64; a longer line is dropped.
A step's log file, past which it moves to the same name ending `.log.1` and a new one starts.
The lines of a step's log the box keeps and writes under a failure's line, from 1 to 100.
